description: The pair-native interchange: one position shape on both forwards, and each row's entity is different text. `{'scope': {'column': 'pairs.entity'}, 'index': -1}` is the last token of THIS row's entity (on the counterfactual, its own entity, `pairs.counterfactual_inputs_variables[0].entity`) — ' Thursday' is three tokens on this tokenizer and ' Friday' one, so the base and the counterfactual are addressed by what they say rather than by a number counted off the end. The window is one token on every row, because 'the last token of' is a question about tokens, which is what makes the swap land where entity_mean_ablation.json's whole-entity read cannot. A row whose entity text is not in its prompt has nothing to write, and the run refuses it by name.
